visualCharacteristics: A section title above a row of streaming service cards with a logo or step image, name, text and link, optionally topped by a dark or orange promo ribbon.
contentPattern: A one-cell row with a heading (+ optional paragraphs) is the section head; each two-cell row is a card: cell 1 the picture (service logo or step image), cell 2 the name heading, text paragraphs and a link paragraph. An italic-only paragraph in cell 2 becomes the promo ribbon (bold italic = orange).
usage: Use to present streaming services, app offers or how-to steps as a row of logo cards with links.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any service or offer card row; use offers for ribbon/promo cards and steps for how-to sequences.
